coin: SHA-256d only. Choose main and backup pools for the same coin and use its payout address or pool account. The pool determines which chain is mined. BCH, BSV, XEC, DGB and PPC use Stratum V1. Peercoin uses proof of work only. DGB requires a SHA-256d port. Bitcoin market data is unavailable for other coins.
pool: A pasted stratum+tcp:// or stratum2+tcp:// address is split for you.
addr: Use the selected coin's address or the account name required by your pool. A worker name can follow: address.worker
diff: Share difficulty asked of the pool; it may choose another.
sv2key: Given by the pool for encrypted V2 connections.
ua: Choose the identity sent to the pool. BDLMinerV2 follows the installed firmware version.
pool2: Used when the main pool keeps failing. Empty = none.
rotateh: 0 = switch only when the main pool fails.
autorot: M5 devices with a motion sensor: the picture turns with the device.
nightfrom: Screen off and no beep. A button press lights it for 30 s.
tz: POSIX TZ, e.g. CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3 or UTC0
ntfy: A long, hard-to-guess name. Empty = off.
hook: JSON POST for Discord, Telegram… It holds a token: keep it private. Empty = off.
summary: Average hashrate, best share, shares and pool connection of the past day. Off = none.
alertpct: Share of the usual full-power hashrate. 0 = off.
fanauto: Manual or temperature-controlled cooling. Changes apply without restarting the ASIC.
fanpct: Used in manual mode. The percentage is a control setting; RPM shows measured speed.
rebooth: Restart after no accepted share for
saver: On battery: dim the screen and mine at half speed.
mqtt: Your Home Assistant broker. Empty = off.
peers: Shown on the dashboard: IP addresses or names, comma separated.
webpass: Optional. Asked before changing settings or installing firmware from these pages. Empty = no password: anyone on your network can.
count: Once a day, downloads a 2-byte file of this version's release. Nothing is sent.
sharehr: Every 5 minutes, sends the firmware version, the board, the cryptocurrency and the hashrate, to count the total of all BDLMiner miners live. No address, name or identifier.
sharepool: On by default. Turn off to hide your pool group. Requires hashrate sharing. Other pools are grouped as private/other. Never sends the hostname, port, Bitcoin address or worker.
remote: Optional. Every five minutes, sends this miner’s readings under its payout address. Open the remote dashboard and enter the same address: nothing to copy. Anyone who knows the address can see them, as on a pool page.
remotekey: Leave empty to use the payout address. A key created before BDLMiner 2.5.4 keeps your readings in a secret space instead; use the same key on every miner.
rname: The name shown in your remote dashboard. Empty uses the board model. Up to 48 bytes.
channel: Beta versions receive the same signature checks and rollback protection.
customscreen: Choose the four metrics and their order on the mining screen.
